context: ASTER-01 locomotion concept trade (synthetic). Options and TRL values are team estimates, not assessed TRLs. Functions refer to functions.csv.
notes: WHEELS+PASSIVE and WHEELS+ACTIVE-RW are excluded because a wheeled concept has no ballistic landing phase to damp or orient; ACTIVE-RW needs camera-aided attitude knowledge. lowg_calc IMP-MAX shows the traction-limited drive acceleration for wheels is only 7.6e-5 m/s2 (mu 0.4), which is why wheels are kept only as a reference.
